subject.title: [Bug]: Session transcript mirroring writes header cwd from process.cwd(), allowing cross-agent workspace contamination

question: Should OpenClaw adopt, rebase, or replace the open linked PR to remove ambient cwd from delivery-mirror transcript header creation?
rationale: The bug is source-backed and crosses session/workspace security boundaries, but an open closing PR already owns the implementation path and is currently conflicting.

options.title: Adopt the narrow transcript fix
options.body: Rebase or replace the linked PR so mirrored transcript header creation receives the target agent workspace explicitly.

options.title: Defer to broader cwd isolation
options.body: Keep the issue open for a larger runtime cleanup, accepting that ordinary mirror headers can still record ambient cwd until then.

options.title: Close the stale PR first
options.body: Close the conflicting PR only after maintainers choose a replacement path so the canonical issue does not lose its fix owner.

recommendation.title: Adopt the narrow transcript fix
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the linked PR so mirrored transcript header creation receives the target agent workspace explicitly.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest history-backed routing candidate for delivery mirror and current transcript helper behavior.
